capabilities: Track cash, bank, and credit-card accounts with balances and utilization
Record expenses, income, refunds, transfers, and card payments manually
Plan monthly budgets per category and currency
Schedule recurring bills and income with manual confirmation
Insert finance references into notes as compact rendered cards
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README stresses deliberate limitations: no bank syncing, exchange rates, automatic posting, or system notifications, and advises backing up the vault before major plugin upgrades.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record transactions, balances, or budgets, so users must leave the vault or use spreadsheets for personal finance.
summary: Local-first personal finance manager that tracks cash, bank, and credit-card accounts, transactions, budgets, and recurring bills in multiple currencies.
